name: generated-agents-inherit-file-access-rule
body:
Every agent agent-builder GENERATES must carry the same positive rule, not just the permission deny. `agent-builder.md`'s "Permission shape common to every generated agent" list (its read-guard bullet) and its step-6 "Verify" checklist must require the generated body to state that graph state is reached only through the apg tools and that the node/transient files are never read directly; the checklist must fail a generated agent whose body claims broader read access than its grant.

Acceptance: the permission-shape list carries the explicit rule and the step-6 checklist names it as a thing to confirm; a generated agent with the read-guard deny but without the rule in its body is a scaffold defect.
